data.one_liner: Detect the language of a given text using character-wise n-gram models.
data.what_it_does: Detects the language of provided text supporting 55 languages out of the box. It provides functions to identify the most likely language or retrieve probabilities for multiple languages.
use_when: You need to automatically detect the language of user input text in your app.
You want a lightweight and fast language detection solution ported from the Python langdetect library.
avoid_when: You require robust support for languages outside of the supported 55 ISO 639-1 codes.
strengths: Supports 55 languages out of the box.
Lightweight and fast character-wise n-gram model.
Simple API with direct detection and probability breakdown functions.
weaknesses: Requires manual initialization via initLangDetect() before use.
License is stated as unknown in the metadata.
data.setup_notes: Must call await langdetect.initLangDetect() once in the application after WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized().
